The '''Trel clan''' was a family of wealthy investors and socialites that had members on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. [[Stubble Trel]] was considered the "black [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]" of the family, yet nonetheless had a net worth of 20 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] simply by virtue of being a member of the clan.<ref name="CatCW" />
